objective: Test full set interactions with two layers of masked multi-head attention over players and a ball token, following the set-attention idea of Ball Radar and PathCRF
inputs: Same raw per-player observations and partitions as V10; ball is an observed token, never reference possession
secondary_camera: Test the frozen trajectory model plus V6 with the frozen V11 alignment and both predeclared ball-fill rules, on clean/moderate/stress external regimes. No changes to synchronization parameters based on possession scores.
criterion: Official spellF1 mean, worst case and per-match results. Exploratory development, no new independent native confirmation claims.
public_policy: No competition ground truth loaded or scored; no manual annotations or frame-specific corrections
